sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: NCCL ring all-reduce：位元組與延遲模型
related.titleEn: NCCL ring all-reduce: byte and latency models
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：相依順序與格數一致，純前向模型標示清楚，延遲與吞吐分開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Dependencies/counts agree, the forward-only scope is explicit, and latency/throughput stay separate.
related.difference: 分清collective語意與具體演算法，計算每rank傳輸量及小訊息延遲項。
related.differenceEn: Separate collective semantics from algorithm choice, and calculate per-rank bytes and latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: p等時階段處理m個microbatch需m+p−1時槽；利用率m/(m+p−1)。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 p4、m8，每階段2 ms，無通訊延遲；只做前向。 11時槽共22 ms；利用率8/11=72.7273%。
ring模型T=2(p−1)α+2(p−1)D/(pB)，包含reduce-scatter與all-gather；非NCCL固定選擇保證。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 p4、D64 MB、B16 GB/s、α=10 μs，每rank同型別同count。 傳輸時間T=6×0.01+1.5×64e6/16e9×1000=6.06 ms。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: p equal stages processing m microbatches require m+p−1 slots; utilization=m/(m+p−1). All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. p4, m8, 2 ms per stage, no communication delay, forward only. 11 slots total 22 ms; utilization8/11=72.7273%.

Ring model T=2(p−1)α+2(p−1)D/(pB), covering reduce-scatter/all-gather; NCCL need not always choose ring. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. p4, D64 decimal MB, B16 GB/s,α10 μs, and identical count/type per rank. T=6×0.01+1.5×64e6/16e9×1000=6.06 ms.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: cuSPARSE CSR：稀疏格式的容量損益
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：相依順序與格數一致，純前向模型標示清楚，延遲與吞吐分開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Dependencies/counts agree, the forward-only scope is explicit, and latency/throughput stay separate.
related.difference: 包含索引計算容量，保留空列與列偏移的正確性。
related.differenceEn: Include indices in capacity and preserve empty-row/offset correctness.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: p等時階段處理m個microbatch需m+p−1時槽；利用率m/(m+p−1)。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 p4、m8，每階段2 ms，無通訊延遲；只做前向。 11時槽共22 ms；利用率8/11=72.7273%。

CSR容量=nnz(valueBytes+indexBytes)+(rows+1)offsetBytes；稠密容量=rows×cols×valueBytes。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 100×100矩陣，FP16值2 bytes、欄索引與列偏移各4 bytes，nnz2000。 CSR=2000×6+101×4=12404 bytes；稠密20000 bytes。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: p equal stages processing m microbatches require m+p−1 slots; utilization=m/(m+p−1). All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. p4, m8, 2 ms per stage, no communication delay, forward only. 11 slots total 22 ms; utilization8/11=72.7273%.

CSR bytes=nnz(valueBytes+indexBytes)+(rows+1)offsetBytes; dense bytes=rows×cols×valueBytes. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 100×100 matrix, FP16 values2 bytes, indices/offsets4 bytes, nnz2000. CSR12404 bytes versus dense20000 bytes.
